Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of UNH.
We delivered record revenue of $3.8 billion this quarter, representing 3% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 60 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2022.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1810 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 3% to 27% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 60 basis points to 39.6%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
